brief: Holds the render passes of a frame and the resources they read and write, and derives their order, lifetimes and shared targets.
detail: A pass declares what it reads and writes; a pass that reads what another writes must run after it, which is an edge, and the order is a topological sort over an ordinary stzGraph. A resource is live from its first write to its last read, and two resources whose lives do not overlap share one physical target, which is memory a hand-ordered frame pays for. Compile derives all of that and proves the frame: acyclic, no read before write, no resource written and never read. Findings go into a stzRuleReport. Execute runs the bodies in order inside one frame on the graphics device, with no window; without a device it answers 0.
receiver:
o1 = new stzFrameGraph(16, 8)
o1.AddPass("Geometry", [ :Writes = [ "colour", "depth" ] ])
o1.AddPass("Blur", [ :Reads = [ "colour" ], :Writes = [ "blurred" ] ])
o1.AddPass("Composite", [ :Reads = [ "colour", "blurred" ], :Writes = [ "screen" ] ])
o1.Compile()
